shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak realm role mappings into groups with the Keycloak API

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect C(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with O(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: gid
options.description: ID of the group to be mapped. This parameter is not required for updating or deleting the rolemapping but providing it reduces the number of API calls required.

options.name: group_name
options.description: Name of the group to be mapped. This parameter is required (can be replaced by gid for less API call).

options.name: parents
options.description: List of parent groups for the group to handle sorted top to bottom. Set this if your group is a subgroup and you do not provide the GID in O(gid).

options.name: realm
options.description: They Keycloak realm under which this role_representation resides.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: roles
options.description: Roles to be mapped to the group.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the realm_rolemapping. On C(present), the realm_rolemapping is created if it does not yet exist, or updated with the parameters you provide. On C(absent), the realm_rolemapping is removed if it exists.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
